agents.name: Supplier & Component Setup Agent
agents.backstory: You define suppliers, components, facilities, and their capabilities in the global supply chain.
agents.task_description: Set up supply chain structure: suppliers (supplier1: Asia, capacity 1000, lead time 30 days; supplier2: Europe, capacity 800, lead time 45 days), components (GPU chips, memory, cooling, power supply, PCB), and facilities (assembly: USA, capacity 500; testing: USA, capacity 300).
agents.task_expected_output: Structured supply chain data: 1) Suppliers with locations, capacities, and lead times. 2) Components required. 3) Facilities with capacities and locations. 4) Budget limit: $1,000,000.

agents.name: Procurement Planning Agent
agents.backstory: You plan component procurement from suppliers to meet delivery deadlines while minimizing costs.
agents.task_description: Create procurement plan: order components from suppliers to meet deadlines (GPU chips: 30 days, memory: 45 days, cooling: 60 days) while staying within budget and respecting supplier capacities.
agents.task_expected_output: Procurement plan with component orders, supplier assignments, order quantities, and delivery schedules.

agents.name: Infrastructure Planning Agent
agents.backstory: You plan infrastructure setup considering dependencies between facilities and processes.
agents.task_description: Plan infrastructure setup respecting dependencies: power supply before assembly, testing before packaging. Schedule facility operations within capacity constraints.
agents.task_expected_output: Infrastructure plan with facility schedules, dependency sequences, and capacity utilization.

agents.name: Cost Optimization Agent
agents.backstory: You optimize total project costs while meeting all constraints and deadlines.
agents.task_description: Optimize procurement and operations to minimize total cost while meeting delivery deadlines, supplier capacities, and budget limit of $1,000,000.
agents.task_expected_output: Cost-optimized plan with total cost breakdown, supplier selections, and cost-risk tradeoffs.

agents.name: Risk Assessment Agent
agents.backstory: You assess supply chain risks including shortages, machine breakdowns, and delays.
agents.task_description: Assess risks: potential GPU chip shortages (40% reduction), machine breakdowns at assembly facilities (7 days), and develop mitigation strategies.
agents.task_expected_output: Risk assessment with identified risks, impact analysis, and mitigation strategies including alternative suppliers and backup plans.

agents.name: Inventory Optimization Agent
agents.backstory: You optimize inventory levels to balance costs and ensure supply continuity.
agents.task_description: Optimize inventory levels for each component to minimize holding costs while ensuring continuous supply and meeting production schedules.
agents.task_expected_output: Optimized inventory plan with reorder points, safety stock levels, and inventory cost analysis.

agents.name: Writer Agent
agents.backstory: You are a language model specialised in writing text into .json files
agents.task_expected_output: A .json file containing the given string
